title: Nova Scotia: Navy divers see occupants beside two saucers on the seabed

tellings.quote: these divers claimed uh that they saw UFO fo occupants outside these two saucers on the on the seabed and and and that they even took video of it

plain: In 1960, off Nova Scotia in Canada, Navy divers are said to have seen occupants standing outside two saucer-shaped craft on the seabed, and even to have taken video of them. A Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet tells Michels this second-hand, passing on what he has from Chris Styles and Brian Fitzpatrick and a source he names as Sweep Clear Five. If true, it would mean crewed craft were operating on the ocean floor and the military had filmed them.
